   SF EASTSIDE INVESTMENTS, LLC'S MOTION TO CORRECT APPLICANTS'
 NOTICE OF COMPLIANCE WITH PREHEARING SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS


       TO THE HONORABLE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW JUDGES:

       SF Eastside Investments, LLC ("SF Eastside" or "Movant"), an intervenor in the above-

captioned proceeding, files this Motion to Correct Applicants' Notice of Compliance with

Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 and, in support thereof,

respectfully shows the following:

                                    I.      INTRODUCTION

       On June 3, 2026, Applicants, Oncor Electric Delivery Company LLC and LCRA

Transmission Services Corporation (collectively, "Applicants"), filed their Notice of Compliance

with Prehearing Submission Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23, including Attachment

2, which Applicants represent serves as the basis for the proposed order of presentation and cross-

examination at the hearing on the merits.


                                            Page 1 of 4
        Upon review of Attachment 2, SF Eastside determined that it was inadvertently omitted

from the list of intervenors despite having timely and actively participated in this proceeding.

       Specifically, Attachment 2 does not identify SF Eastside Investments, LLC as an

intervening party opposing Segment Link U1, notwithstanding that SF Eastside has formally

appeared, filed testimony, and notified the parties of its intent to participate in the hearing.

                                  II.     FACTUAL BACKGROUND

       SF Eastside Investments, LLC is a party of record in this docket.

       On April 27, 20926, SF Eastside Investments, LLC, timely filed its motion to intervene in

these proceedings, Interchange Item No. 2617. On May 13, 2026, SF Eastside timely filed its

Statement of Position and Direct Testimony, Interchange Item No. 4378. In its Statement of

Position and Direct Testimony, SF Eastside expressly identified itself as an intervenor and

articulated its opposition to the routing alternative affecting its property interests, including the

proposed Link U1 segment. Thereafter, SF Eastside further confirmed its intent to participate in

the hearing by filing its Notice of Attendance at Hearing, accepted by the Commission as

Interchange Item No. 4969.

                           III.         MOTION TO CORRECT NOTICE

       SOAH Order No. 23 directed Applicants to prepare and file a spreadsheet listing

intervenors, grouped by route segments, and advised that the spreadsheet would serve as the basis

for the order of presentation and cross-examination at hearing.

       The omission of SF Eastside from Attachment 2 appears to be an administrative oversight

rather than a substantive determination regarding party status. Nevertheless, if left uncorrected, the

omission could create unnecessary confusion concerning SF Eastside's participation during the




                                              Page 2 of 4
 hearing on the merits and prejudice its ability to efficiently present evidence and cross-examine

witnesses.

       Because SF Eastside timely filed its Statement of Position and Direct Testimony and

subsequently filed its Notice of Attendance at Hearing, there is no legitimate basis for excluding it

from Attachment 2. Accordingly, good cause exists for the Presiding Administrative Law Judges

to direct Applicants to amend Attachment 2 to include SF Eastside Investments, LLC as an

intervenor opposing Segment Link U1 and to revise the proposed order of presentation and cross-

examination accordingly.

                                         IV.     PRAYER

       WHEREFORE, PREMISES CONSIDERED, SF Eastside Investments, LLC respectfully

requests that the Presiding Administrative Law Judges:

   1. Grant this Motion;

   2. Order Applicants to correct their Notice of Compliance with Prehearing Submission

       Requirements in SOAH Order Nos. 6 and 23 by amending Attachment 2 to include SF

       Eastside Investments, LLC as an intervenor associated with and opposing Segment Link

       U1;

   3. Direct that the corrected Attachment 2 be used as the basis for the order of presentation and

       cross-examination at the hearing on the merits; and

   4. Grant SF Eastside Investments, LLC such other and further relief to which it may be justly

       entitled.




       Respectfully submitted,

        Date: June 5, 2026
